children: Overview
UK market-data software firm's revenue fell 11.5% in fiscal year, mainly on customer loss
Profit before tax declined year-on-year but was marginally ahead of company-compiled market expectations
Company maintained final dividend at 4.00p per share
Outlook
Company expects a return to growth in the next financial year
Arcontech sees strong pipeline of prospective customers but notes long and complex sales cycles
Company says recent product enhancements expected to support longer-term growth
Result Drivers
CUSTOMER LOSS - Revenue decline was mainly due to loss of a large long-standing customer and delays in purchasing decisions by prospective customers
NEW CUSTOMER ADDED - Addition of a major European customer expected to restore recurring revenue run rate
PRODUCT ENHANCEMENTS - Company expanded product functionality and support team to appeal to wider customer base
